<!id: enhance.classpath.check>
<!description: Extend IJavaProject.isOnClasspath() check with IJavaProject.equals() for improved logic to handle cases where the project itself is the element being checked.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$x.isOnClasspath($y) :: instanceof($x, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IJavaProject")
=>
$x.equals($y) || $x.isOnClasspath($y)
;;
